list.title: Subagents
list.subtitle: Specialized agents the main Claude can delegate to. Each runs in its own context window with its own system prompt and tool restrictions.

empty.title: No subagents yet
empty.description: Subagents help you preserve context, enforce tool restrictions, and route tasks to faster models. They're invoked by Claude based on their description, or via @-mention.

editor.subtitleCreate: Define a specialized subagent. Claude delegates based on the description.
editor.subtitleEdit: Subagent definition. Claude delegates based on the description.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete subagent "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
editor.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; must start with a letter. Saved as `.claude/agents/<name>.md`.
editor.cantParseStructured: Frontmatter can't be parsed as YAML — switch to Raw to fix it.

fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Reviews code for correctness, security, and maintainability. Use proactively after code changes.
fields.descriptionHelp: Tells Claude when to delegate. Be specific — including "use proactively" encourages auto-delegation.
fields.toolsHelp: Allowlist. Empty = the subagent inherits every tool from the main session.

editor.bodyPlaceholder: You are a senior code reviewer. Focus on correctness, security, and maintainability. Always provide a concrete fix with each finding.

errors.invalidName: Name must start with a lowercase letter and use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
errors.alreadyExists: A subagent with this name already exists.
errors.notFound: This subagent no longer exists on disk.
errors.conflict: This subagent was modified outside Nakiros. Reload to see the latest version.
